title: Lifetime Care and Support Scheme (icare)
summary: This page provides information about the Lifetime Care and Support Scheme (icare), which helps people who need ongoing care and support.
who_can_apply: Eligibility depends on your specific needs and circumstances.

faqs.q: What is the Lifetime Care and Support Scheme (icare)?
faqs.a: The Lifetime Care and Support Scheme (icare) provides support for people who need ongoing care and support.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for care and support?
faqs.a: Eligibility depends on your specific needs and circumstances. You should check the official iCare website for detailed information.

faqs.q: Where can I find more information about iCare?
faqs.a: You can visit the official iCare website or the Service NSW directory for more details.
